systems.system: Decentralizing Access to Child Development Indicators project
systems.owner: UNICEF, Ministry of Local Government and Chieftainship Affairs and Limkokwing University
systems.tiers: planned in 2018: dashboards of child development indicators for district, urban and community councils, drawing on ministries' information systems

note: The passages describe decentralisation and a planned dashboards project for councils; nothing states that council offices are connected or how. The report gives the administrative divisions as of 2018: 10 district councils, 1 municipal council, 10 urban councils and 65 community councils.
